newsReports.title: Brighton Hove Holds Premier League DFT Lead on 15 Pts Ahead of Arsenal (13 Pts)
newsReports.summary: Brighton Hove leads the Premier League two-half table on 15 points ahead of Arsenal, while Arsenal tops full-time standings.
newsReports.lead_narrative: Brighton Hove paces the Premier League (PL) two-half standings with 15 points (+7 WP) ahead of Arsenal (13 points) on 2026-11-24. Meanwhile, Arsenal holds first place in the standard full-time table on 27 points (+14 WP), highlighting contrasting paths to points accumulation.
story_body: At the top of the Premier League two-half standings, the leading trio sits at 1. Brighton Hove (15 pts, +7 WP), 2. Arsenal (13 pts, +14 WP), and 3. Bournemouth (13 pts, +2 WP). Brighton Hove holds a 2-point cushion over Arsenal and leads third-placed Bournemouth by 2 points.

The standard full-time standings present a contrasting picture, led by Arsenal (27 pts, +14 WP), Brighton Hove (22 pts, +7 WP), and Man City (21 pts, +10 WP). Arsenal stays 5 points clear of Brighton Hove in full-time points, and Weak Points (STD minus DFT) show the largest positive cushions on Arsenal (+14 WP: 27 STD vs 13 DFT), Man City (+10 WP: 21 STD vs 11 DFT), and Liverpool (+9 WP: 18 STD vs 9 DFT) while Bournemouth posts the lowest Weak Points tally at +2 WP, reflecting points collected from draws or single-half wins.

At the opposite end of the Premier League two-half table, Sunderland (2 pts, +6 WP), Man United (2 pts, +6 WP), and Nottingham (3 pts, +6 WP) sit under sustained points pressure, while Crystal Palace (7 pts), Sunderland (8 pts), and Man United (8 pts) occupy the lower full-time spots.

Across other tracked top-flight competitions on 2026-11-24, table leaders include Bundesliga (RB Leipzig on 16 two-half pts; Bayern on 21 full-time pts; max WP: Dortmund +12), Campeonato Brasileiro Serie A (Flamengo on 52 two-half pts; Flamengo on 79 full-time pts; max WP: Cruzeiro +37), Eredivisie (PSV on 26 two-half pts; PSV on 26 full-time pts; max WP: Sittard +12), Ligue 1 (PSG on 14 two-half pts; PSG on 23 full-time pts; max WP: Paris FC +11), La Liga (Barça on 27 two-half pts; Barça on 33 full-time pts; max WP: Atleti +15), Primeira Liga (SL Benfica on 18 two-half pts; Porto on 33 full-time pts; max WP: Porto +16), and Serie A (Roma on 20 two-half pts; Lazio on 29 full-time pts; max WP: Inter +18).
